title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E23 — A Is for Arson
When firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled to be arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide; a serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit, but it takes a dogged cold-case detective to track down the real killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E18 — One Tough Mother
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Okla.; DNA evidence points to her killer over a decade later and leads to the buried bodies of two other missing women in Texas.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E16 — The Clock Strikes Murder
When 23-year-old Tonya McKinley is found brutally murdered on New Year's Day 1985, a boy is left motherless; a family waits 35 years for advancements in forensic science to finally catch a killer using familial DNA.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E20 — Cold Ashes
When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and a mother goes on a decadeslong crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E14 — No Known Enemies
When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Mich., wonder who would murder this pillar of the community; it will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E15 — Contracted to Kill
When 37-year-old Lee Rotatori is found dead in her hotel room in 1982 with a single stab wound to the heart, police suspect the work of a professional; it takes four decades to identify her killer and, in the process, reveal a shocking truth.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E17 — The Campfire Mint Murder
When 9-year-old Campfire Girl, Candy Rogers, turns up dead after selling mints door-to-door, Spokane detectives launch a dogged campaign to find her killer. One of the longest Cold Case investigations in Washington State history.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E02 — Hannah Payne
Hannah Payne is on trial for the murder of Kenneth Herring, a motorist who fled the scene of an accident; she claims Herring accidentally shot himself with her gun; eyewitness cell phone videos tell a different story.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E11 — Mauricio Guerrero
An online fantasy romance goes wrong when Mauricio Guerrero breaks into the home of an OnlyFans content creator; Guerrero takes the stand in an effort to convince the jury it was all an act of sexual role play.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E10 — Demarcus Little
Active-duty Army Sergeant DeMarcus Little is on trial for the murder of his ex-girlfriend Anitra Gunn; Little decides to testify in his own defense to tell the jury he would never harm his soulmate.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E08 — Richard Merritt
After months on the run, disgraced attorney Richard Merritt faces trial for the brutal murder of his 77-year-old mother; the defense claims Shirley was murdered in an act of revenge by Richard's previous fraud victims.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E03 — Darrin Lopez
Darrin Lopez faces a murder charge for shooting his girlfriend's husband; investigators discover there's much more to the story than a simple love triangle gone wrong; can Lopez's testimony convince jurors this was a justified killing?

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E05 — Charlie Adelson
Charlie Adelson stands accused of hiring two hitmen to murder his ex-brother-in-law, Dan Markel, in order to free his sister from a nasty child custody dispute; according to Adelson, he's also a victim, claiming the hitmen extorted him.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S04 E01 — Richard Acosta
Richard Acosta, Jr. is being tried for capital murder, accused of being the getaway driver for his 14-year-old son, Abel; surveillance footage at a Texas convenience store captures Abel shooting four teens, killing three; Abel remains at large.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E08 — Killer Cried Wolf
In the early hours of September 6th, 2020, local police receive a distressing 911 call from 32-year-old Brian Redding.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E07 — A Night Terror
Officers investigate the murder of 19-year-old Amber Meadows and hunt the four perpetrators responsible for the crime.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E06 — A Chance Encounter
January 5, 2016, Baltimore, MD: Police officers respond to a report of a deceased man found at the Deluxe Plaza Motel in Northeast Baltimore; the victim, US Navy Veteran Edward Yesaitis, was discovered by the motel's cleaning crew.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E05 — A Krazy Killing
Deputies from the Riverside County Sheriff's Department respond to the scene of an abandoned vehicle in a remote area of the Gavilan Hills; investigators discovered corpses of two men stuffed in the trunk.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E04 — Murder in the Parish
The Sheriff's Office in DeRidder, LA, receives a distressing phone call from the owner of Dee's Motel; the man tells them that he's found a woman dead in room six.

title: Murder at the Motel
description:
S01 E02 — The Bad Guy Did It
Officers from the Reno Police Department are dispatched to the La Quinta Inn, where they discover the remains of a 42-year-old woman who was shot 23 times, and a key piece of evidence is from one of the victim's sons.

title: The Real SVU
description:
S01 E01 — Murder at Soho House
